titleEnglish: 3 · In Praise of the Prophet ﷺ

verses.ar: ظَلَمْتُ سُنَّةَ مَنْ أَحْيَا الظَّلاَمَ إِلَى ۞ أَنِ اشْتَكَتْ قَدَمَاهُ الضُّرَّ مِنْ وَرَمِ
verses.tr: Ẓalamtu sunnata man aḥyādh ẓalāma ilā · Anishtakat qadamāhuḍ ḍurra min warami
verses.en: I have wronged the way of him who kept the nights alive in prayer until his feet complained of the hurt of swelling.

verses.ar: وَشَدَّ مِنْ سَغَبٍ أَحْشَاءَهُ وَطَوَى ۞ تَحْتَ الْحِجَارَةِ كَشْحًا مُتْرَفَ الْأَدَمِ
verses.tr: Wa shadda min saghabin aḥshāʾahu wa ṭawā · Taḥtal ḥijārati kash-ḥan mutrafal adami
verses.en: From hunger he bound in his belly, and folded beneath a stone a waist of soft and delicate skin.

verses.ar: وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الْجِبَالُ الشُّمُّ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ ۞ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَأَرَاهَا أَيَّمَا شَمَمِ
verses.tr: Wa rāwadat-hul jibālush shummu min dhahabin · ʿAn nafsihi fa arāhā ayyamā shamami
verses.en: The lofty mountains offered to become gold to tempt him, but he showed them a loftiness far above their own.

verses.ar: وَأَكَّدَتْ زُهْدَهُ فِيهَا ضَرُورَتُهُ ۞ إِنَّ الضَّرُورَةَ لاَ تَعْدُو عَلٰى الْعِصَمِ
verses.tr: Wa akkadat zuhdahu fīhā ḍarūratuhu · Innaḍ ḍarūrata lā taʿdū ʿalal ʿiṣami
verses.en: His very need only confirmed his detachment from them — for need never transgresses against the divinely protected.

verses.ar: وَكَيْفَ تَدْعُو إِلَى الدُّنْيَا ضَرُورَةُ مَنْ ۞ لَوْلاَهُ لَمْ تُخْرَجِ الدُّنْيَا مِنَ الْعَدَمِ
verses.tr: Wa kayfa tadʿū ilad dunyā ḍarūratu man · Lawlāhu lam tukhrajid dunyā minal ʿadami
verses.en: And how could need summon to worldliness the one but for whom the world would never have been drawn out of nothingness?

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ سَيِّدُ الْكَوْنَيْنِ وَالثَّقَلَيْنِ ۞ وَالفَرِيقَيْنِ مِنْ عُرْبٍ وَمِنْ عَجَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun sayyidul kawnayni wath thaqalayni · wal farīqayni min ʿurbin wa min ʿajami
verses.en: Muhammad, master of the two worlds, of both jinn and mankind, and of the two peoples, Arab and non-Arab.

verses.ar: نَبِيُّنَا الْآمِرُ النَّاهِي فَلاَ أَحَدٌ ۞ أَبَرَّ فِي قَوْلِ لاَ مِنْهُ وَلاَ نَعَمِ
verses.tr: Nabiyyunal āmirun nāhī falā aḥadun · Abarra fī qawli lā minhu wa lā naʿami
verses.en: Our Prophet, who commands and forbids — none is more truthful than he in a 'no' or a 'yes'.

verses.ar: هُوَ الْحَبِيبُ الذِّي تُرْجَى شَفَاعَتُهُ ۞ لِكُلِّ هَوْلٍ مِنَ الْأَهْوَالِ مُقْتَحَمِ
verses.tr: Huwal ḥabībul ladhī turjā shafāʿatuhu · Li kulli hawlin minal ahwāli muqtaḥami
verses.en: He is the Beloved whose intercession is hoped for against every terror that comes crashing down.

verses.ar: دَعَا إِلَى اللّٰهِ فَالْمُسْتَمْسِكُونَ بِهِ ۞ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ بِحَبْلٍ غَيْرِ مُنْفَصِمِ
verses.tr: Daʿā ilaLlāhi fal mustamsikūna bihi · Mustamsikūna biḥablin ghayri munfaṣimi
verses.en: He called to Allah; so those who hold fast to him hold fast to a rope that will never break.

verses.ar: فَاقَ النَّبِيّينَ فِي خَلْقٍ وَفِي خُلُقٍ ۞ وَلَمْ يُدَانُوهُ فِي عِلْمٍ وَلاَ كَرَمِ
verses.tr: Fāqan nabiyyīna fī khalqin wa fī khuluqin · Wa lam yudānūhu fī ʿilmin wa lā karami
verses.en: He surpassed the Prophets in form and in character, and they did not draw near him in knowledge or in nobility.

verses.ar: وَكُلُّهُمْ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ مُلْتَمِسٌ ۞ غَرْفًا مِنَ الْبَحْرِ أَوْ رَشْفًا مِنَ الدِّيَمِ
verses.tr: Wa kulluhum min rasūliLlāhi multamisun · Gharfan minal baḥri aw rashfan minad diyami
verses.en: Each of them seeks from the Emissary of Allah a handful from his sea, or a sip from his gentle rains.

verses.ar: وَوَاقِفُونَ لَدَيْهِ عِنْدَ حَدِّهِمِ ۞ مِنْ نُقْطَةِ الْعِلْمِ أَوْ مِنْ شَكْلَةِ الْحِكَمِ
verses.tr: Wa wāqifūna ladayhi ʿinda ḥaddihimi · Min nuqṭatil ʿilmi aw min shaklatil ḥikami
verses.en: And they stand before him, each at his own limit — a single dot of his knowledge, or one vowel-mark of his wisdom.

verses.ar: فَهْوَ الذِّي تَمَّ مَعْنَاهُ وَصُورَتُهُ ۞ ثُمَّ اصْطَفَاهُ حَبِيبًا بَارِئُ النَّسَمِ
verses.tr: Fa huwal ladhī tamma maʿnāhu wa ṣūratuhu · Thummaṣṭafāhu ḥabīban bāriʾun nasami
verses.en: He is the one whose inner meaning and outer form were made perfect; then the Fashioner of souls chose him as His beloved.

verses.ar: مُنَزَّهٌ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ فِي مَحَاسِنِهِ ۞ فَجَوْهَرُ الْحُسْنِ فِيهِ غَيْرُ مُنْقَسِمِ
verses.tr: Munazzahun ʿan sharīkin fī maḥāsinihi · Fa jawharul ḥusni fīhi ghayru munqasimi
verses.en: Far above having any rival in his excellences — for in him the essence of beauty is undivided.

verses.ar: دَعْ مَا ادَّعَتْهُ النَّصَارَى فِي نَبِيِّهِمِ ۞ وَاحْكُمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ مَدْحًا فِيهِ وَاحْتَكِمِ
verses.tr: Daʿ maddaʿat-hun naṣārā fī nabiyyihimi · Waḥkum bimā shiʾta mad-ḥan fīhi waḥtakimi
verses.en: Leave aside what the Christians claimed of their prophet; then decree what praise you will of him, and judge freely.

verses.ar: وَانْسُبْ إِلَى ذَاتِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَرَفٍ ۞ وَانْسُبْ إِلَى قَدْرِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ عِظَمِ
verses.tr: Wansub ilā dhātihi mā shiʾta min sharafin · Wansub ilā qadrihi mā shiʾta min ʿiẓami
verses.en: Ascribe to his person what nobility you will, and ascribe to his rank what greatness you will.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ فَضْلَ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ ۞ حَدٌّ فَيُعْرِبَ عَنْهُ نَاطِقٌ بِفَمِ
verses.tr: Fa inna faḍla rasūliLlāhi laysa lahu · Ḥaddun fa yuʿriba ʿanhu nāṭiqun bifami
verses.en: For the excellence of Allah's Emissary has no limit that a speaker could ever put into words with his mouth.

verses.ar: لَوْ نَاسَبَتْ قَدْرَهُ آيَاتُهُ عِظَمًا ۞ أَحْيَا اسْمُهُ حِينَ يُدْعَى دَارِسَ الرِّمَمِ
verses.tr: Law nāsabat qadrahu āyātuhu ʿiẓaman · Aḥyaʾsmuhu ḥīna yudʿā dārisar rimami
verses.en: Had his miracles matched his rank in greatness, the mere calling of his name would revive bones long decayed.

verses.ar: لَمْ يَمْتَحِنَّا بِمَا تَعْيَا الْعُقُولُ بِهِ ۞ حِرْصًا عَلَيْنَا فَلَمْ نَرْتَبْ وَلَمْ نَهِمْ
verses.tr: Lam yamtaḥinnā bimā taʿyal ʿuqūlu bihi · Ḥirṣan ʿalayna falam nartab wa lam nahimi
verses.en: Out of care for us he did not test us with what the minds cannot bear, so we neither doubted nor lost our way.

verses.ar: أَعْيَا الْوَرَى فَهْمُ مَعْنَاهُ فَلَيْسَ يُرَى ۞ فِي الْقُرْبِ وَالْبُعْدِ فِيهِ غَيْرُ مُنْفَحِمِ
verses.tr: Aʿyal warā fahmu maʿnāhu falaysa yurā · Fīl qurbi wal buʿdi fīhi ghayru munfaḥimi
verses.en: Grasping his reality has wearied all creation; near or far, none is seen before him but the dumbstruck.

verses.ar: كَالشَّمْسِ تَظْهَرُ لِلْعَيْنَيْنِ مِنْ بُعُدٍ ۞ صَغِيرَةً وَتُكِلُّ الطَّرْفَ مِنْ أَمَمِ
verses.tr: Kash shamsi taẓ-haru lil ʿaynayni min buʿudin · Ṣaghīratan wa tukilluṭ ṭarfa min amami
verses.en: Like the sun, which appears small to the eyes from afar, yet overwhelms the sight when close at hand.

verses.ar: وَكَيْفَ يُدْرِكُ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَقِيقَتَهُ ۞ قَوْمٌ نِيَامٌ تَسَلَّوْا عَنْهُ بِالحُلُمِ
verses.tr: Wa kayfa yudriku fid dunyā ḥaqīqatahu · Qawmun niyāmun tasallū ʿanhu bil ḥulumi
verses.en: How could his reality be grasped in this world by a sleeping people, content to know him only through dreams?

verses.ar: فَمَبْلَغُ الْعِلْمِ فِيهِ أَنَّهُ بَشَرٌ ۞ وَأَنَّهُ خَيْرُ خَلْقِ اللّٰهِ كُلِّهِمِ
verses.tr: Fa mablaghul ʿilmi fīhi annahu basharun · Wa annahu khayru khalqiLlāhi kullihimi
verses.en: The utmost our knowledge reaches of him is that he is a man, and that he is the best of all Allah's creation.

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ آيٍ أَتَى الرُّسْلُ الْكِرَامُ بِهَا ۞ فَإِنَّمَا اتَّصَلَتْ مِنْ نُوِرِهِ بِهِمِ
verses.tr: Wa kullu āyin atar ruslul kirāmu bihā · Fa innamat taṣalat min nūrihi bihimi
verses.en: Every sign the noble Emissaries brought reached them only through connection with his light.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُ شَمْسُ فَضْلٍ هُمْ كَوَاكِبُهَا ۞ يُظْهِرْنَ أَنْوَارَهاَ لِلنَّاسِ فِي الظُّلَمِ
verses.tr: Fa innahu shamsu faḍlin hum kawākibuhā · Yuẓ-hirna anwārahā lin nāsi fidh ẓulami
verses.en: For he is the sun of grace, and they are its stars, showing forth its lights to people in the darkness.

verses.ar: أَكْرِمْ بِخَلْقِ نَبِيٍ زَانَهُ خُلُقٌ ۞ بِالحُسْنِ مُشْتَمِلٍ بِالبِشْرِ مُتَّسِمِ
verses.tr: Akrim bikhalqi nabiyyin zānahu khuluqun · Bil ḥusni mushtamilin bil bishri muttasimi
verses.en: How noble the form of a Prophet adorned by character — wrapped in beauty, marked by a cheerful, smiling face.

verses.ar: كَالزَّهْرِ فِي تَرَفٍ وَالبَدْرِ فِي شَرَفٍ ۞ وَالبَحْرِ فِي كَرَمٍ وَالدَّهْرِ فِي هِمَمِ
verses.tr: Kaz zahri fī tarafin wal badri fī sharafin · Wal baḥri fī karamin wad dahri fī himami
verses.en: Like the flower in delicate beauty, the full moon in honour, the sea in generosity, and all of time in resolve.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّه وَهْوَ فَرْدٌ مِنْ جَلاَلَتِهِ ۞ فِي عَسْكَرٍ حِينَ تَلْقَاهُ وَفِي حَشَمِ
verses.tr: Ka annahu wa huwa fardun min jalālatihi · Fī ʿaskarin ḥīna talqāhu wa fī ḥashami
verses.en: So great his majesty that, though alone when you meet him, he seems amid an army and a retinue.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّمَا اللُّؤْلُؤْ الْمَكْنُونُ فِي صَدَفٍ ۞ مِنْ مَعْدِنَيْ مَنْطِقٍ مِنْهُ وَمُبْتَسِمِ
verses.tr: Ka annamal luʾluʾul maknūnu fī ṣadafin · Min maʿdinay manṭiqin minhu wa mubtasami
verses.en: As if guarded pearls in their shells came forth from the twin mines of his speech and his smile.

verses.ar: لاَ طِيبَ يَعْدِلُ تُرْبًا ضَمَّ أَعْظُمَهُ ۞ طُوبىَ لِمُنْتَشِقٍ مِنْهُ وَمُلْتَثِمِ
verses.tr: Lā ṭība yaʿdilu turban ḍamma aʿẓumahu · Ṭūbā li muntashiqin minhu wa multathimi
verses.en: No perfume equals the earth that embraces his blessed remains; blessed is the one who breathes its scent or kisses it.
